'''2012 European Championship Chris Williams DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Williams]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif}}
* '''Username:''' TrueMisterSlk
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
